svg.title: SemRisk P1-R2 asserted object-property relation map
svg.desc: All 37 locally declared object properties. For each, the asserted OWL domain and range are shown, or explicitly marked not asserted. Arrows indicate domain to relation to range, not data flow or cardinality.
svg.text: 37 local OWL object properties · 19 asserted domain statements · 25 asserted range statements
P1-R2 0.1.0-rc.1 · source ref c17cc111f02309270a60474623259cefcf907c6f · missing domain/range means not asserted locally

Arrows express the asserted property signature only. OWL domain/range infer types; they do not validate row completeness. Cardinalities, SHACL, SQL, inverses and inferred/imported effects are separate.
